mistake.hook: English speakers ALWAYS get this wrong 🙈
mistake.rule: After a modal (will, muss, kann…), the 2nd verb goes to the end — no „zu".

caption:
STOP adding „zu" after modal verbs 🙈

❌ Ich will Deutsch ZU lernen.
✅ Ich will Deutsch lernen.

English says „want TO learn" — so learners add „zu". But after a German modal verb (will, muss, kann, soll, darf, mag), the second verb jumps to the END with NO „zu".
